subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Brooklyn Bridge
description: A 60-second lesson on The Brooklyn Bridge.

hook.text: The Brooklyn Bridge was the longest suspension bridge in the world when it opened in 1883.

buildup.text: Its designer, John Roebling, died from an injury before construction began. His son Washington took over.

discovery.text: Workers dug underwater in sealed chambers called caissons. Many got decompression sickness—'the bends.'

twist.text: Washington Roebling was paralyzed by the bends. His wife Emily directed construction as his intermediary.

climax.text: Emily Roebling was the first person to cross the finished bridge. She was its unsung builder.

punchline.text: Three Roeblings built the Brooklyn Bridge. Emily finished it.

quiz.question: Who directed construction of the Brooklyn Bridge after Washington Roebling was paralyzed?
